description: EPANET-RTX is a programming library for real-time hydraulic models, combining time-series sensor sources, model parameters and repeated simulations. This resource is provided by OpenWaterAnalytics (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: BSD-2-Clause. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The README describes building blocks for programmers, not a ready-to-use operator application. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
